channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike James | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike James from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Vincent Poirier on Evan Fournier, Mike James
item.description:
“I also saw Evan (Fournier)’s tweets and Mike James’ tweets. Yes, he might have said that to motivate his team, but it shows how hard all European teams play. Malaga (Unicaja) is not even a EuroLeague team, yet they beat the best team in the G League. I don’t think the G League is even a real league.”

Vincent Poirier on Evan Fournier, Mike James, Sep 20, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: David Blatt on Mike James, Kemba Walker
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:David Blatt on Kemba Walker at @SportalgrG:

“I can say that I am happy for Kemba, that he has found a new home. He will have the challenge of playing in the Euroleague. It is very interesting that he will be on the same team with a player like Mike James”

David Blatt on Mike James, Kemba Walker, Jul 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Steve Nash on Mike James
item.description:
Steve Nash also says,

“Mike (James) brought us another playmaker — We gave him a look and he played very well in Game 1.”

Steve Nash on Mike James, Jun 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @ajayibrowne.

item.title: Steve Nash on Mike James
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on whether Mike James will be picked up beyond his 10-day and kept for the playoffs:

“I’d imagine he’s going to be with us,but I can’t confirm anything.”

Steve Nash on Mike James, May 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Nash on Mike James
item.description:
Nets Daily:Steve Nash on Mike James:

“Still haven’t met him but, he’s a scorer. He was one of the top players in Europe. He’s played in the NBA. I think he gives us some ball-handling as well. I think he’s got to play tonight, frankly,”

Steve Nash on Mike James, Apr 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @NetsDaily.
